description: This file contains the implementation of the AdoNetGrainDirectory class, which manages grain address lookup, registration, and unregistration in an Orleans distributed system using ADO.NET. It includes methods for operating on grain activation data and handles external database queries and logging.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implementation of the IGrainDirectory interface that uses ADO.NET for persistence, managing grain address lookups and registrations.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the grain address for a given grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a new grain address or returns the existing one.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations associated with a list of silo addresses.

methods.name: GetQueriesAsync
methods.description: Ensures lazy, thread-safe loading of the relational queries object used for database operations.
